title: planning-dashboard
description: Root node for the proposed Pi Cartographer planning dashboard CLI and skill.

title: Package manifest
description: Declares the Pi package resources, runtime dependencies, npm scripts, and future dashboard CLI bin entry.

title: Project README
description: Documents Cartographer workflows, planning artifacts, lifecycle states, helper CLI commands, and JSONL graph artifacts.

title: Cartographer extension tools
description: Registers deterministic Pi tools that wrap index, JSONL, evidence, and session helper CLIs with shaped output.

title: Proposal skill
description: Defines the proposal workflow and required proposal/map/fact artifacts under .plan/<topic>/.

title: Plan skill
description: Defines plan.md plus plan graph artifacts, phase states, and source artifact expectations.

title: Implement skill
description: Defines implementation execution, phase status updates, validation receipts, reviewer gates, and commits.

title: Project index CLI
description: Builds and queries the SQLite/FTS5 project graph and writes topic map JSONL slices used by dashboard link resolution.

title: Planning JSONL helper
description: Validates topic JSONL artifacts, fact citations, lifecycle metadata, and retrieval miss records.

title: Planning graph validator
description: Performs deeper validation for map/fact/plan graph resolution, citations, lifecycle states, and phase DAGs.

title: Workflow benchmark helper
description: Computes topic metrics from plan nodes, receipts, context packs, validation receipts, and optional session summaries.

title: ADR records helper
description: Provides ADR directory, Markdown, graph, validation, lookup, creation, and currentness semantics that dashboard ADR metrics can consume.

title: ADR feature proposal
description: Prior rationale for first-class ADR management, ADR graph records, currentness, and durable decision lookup.

title: ADR feature plan
description: Implementation plan showing ADR graph phases, statuses, validation receipts, and current feature progress patterns.

title: Project instructions
description: Requires tests and exploratory commands that create planning artifacts to use temporary mock repositories rather than the real .plan directory.

title: cartographer-dashboard CLI
description: Proposed installed Node CLI that starts/stops/statuses a local dashboard server for a selected repository root.

title: dashboard skill
description: Proposed Pi skill that invokes the installed dashboard CLI to start, stop, or inspect the local dashboard for the user.

title: Dashboard server
description: Proposed local read-only HTTP/API server that scans .plan artifacts, ADR graph files, and source files safely.

title: Dashboard client
description: Proposed Vite/React client that renders overview metrics, topic pages, Markdown, code, and graph explorer views.

title: Taste profile
description: User-provided aesthetic direction: dark tactile UI, material depth, visible feedback, purposeful motion, and color as wayfinding.
